The code behind the writing. Every figure and every number on this site
regenerates from one of these repositories.

<!-- The rows ARE the homepage listing's rows — same grid, same two registers —
     because the site's cohesion rule is few materials used often, and a list of
     work is a list of work. The shared geometry is a mixin in styles.scss so the
     two cannot drift.

     The names are `p` + role=heading, not h2, for the same reason the homepage
     kickers are: the section-numeral machinery is scoped to `main.content h2`
     and would stamp a gutter "01"–"05" down this page. Those numerals mean
     "section N of an argument"; five instruments are a set, not a sequence.

     BOTH DESTINATIONS ARE NAMED (2026-08-06, Ameya's catch). The first build
     made the repo name itself the only link to the repo, on the reasoning that
     a repo name is self-evidently a repo. It is not: an underline says "link",
     it does not say "GitHub", and the row read as though the code were missing
     from the page whose entire job is to point at the code. The name is now
     plain text — it is the row's title — and the two destinations sit together
     in the filing register underneath, where a reader can see there are two.

     Every row that has a post links to it. That is the whole reason this page
     can exist without becoming a gallery: nothing here floats free of the
     writing that explains what it was for. -->
